name: python-prefix-trie
title: Prefix Trie
blurb: A string-keyed trie over lowercase words: membership answers equal a set's, every prefix listing equals the sorted scan of the corpus, delete drops only the exact word, and the empty prefix lists every word exactly once.
default_description: A string-keyed trie over lowercase words whose prefix listing equals the sorted scan on any seeded corpus.

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --python 3.12 --allow-existing && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

detect.contains: a word ends where it is whole
